title: Study of a water jar
provenance: Acquired by the Estate of Rajah Raja Mohan in 1927, later sold to the estate of merchant Haridas Lall in 1949. Provenance Chain: Estate of Prof. J. Anandakrishnan acquired at auction from Soh Yih Hock's estate in 1985 and inherited by family friend Dr. Ganesan Sundaram in 1997.
